name: primary immunodeficiency syndrome due to p14 deficiency
description: Primary immunodeficiency syndrome due to p14 deficiency is characterized by short stature, hypopigmentation, coarse facies and frequent bronchopulmonary Streptococcus pneumoniae infections.
